name: Get Issue Picker Suggestions
description: Returns lists of issues matching a query string. [See the documentation](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/api-group-issue-search/#api-rest-api-3-issue-picker-get)

configurable_props.name: query
configurable_props.label: Query
configurable_props.description: A string to match against text fields in the issue such as title, description, or comments

configurable_props.name: currentJQL
configurable_props.label: Current JQL
configurable_props.description: A JQL query defining a list of issues to search for the query term. Note that `username` and `userkey` cannot be used as search terms for this parameter, due to privacy reasons. Use `accountId` instead

configurable_props.name: currentIssueKey
configurable_props.label: Current Issue Key
configurable_props.description: The key of an issue to exclude from search results. For example, the issue the user is viewing when they perform this query

configurable_props.name: currentProjectId
configurable_props.label: Current Project ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of a project that suggested issues must belong to

configurable_props.name: showSubTasks
configurable_props.label: Show Sub Tasks
configurable_props.description: Indicate whether to include subtasks in the suggestions list

configurable_props.name: showSubTaskParent
configurable_props.label: Show Sub Task Parent
configurable_props.description: When `currentIssueKey` is a subtask, whether to include the parent issue in the suggestions if it matches the query
